gates.question: How does the off-domain name check treat a name found in a candidate line only inside a hyphenated word?
options: hyphen part alone does not hold the name
no compound part (hyphen, dot, camel) holds the name
gates.recommendation: hyphen part alone does not hold the name
gates.answer: a hyphen part alone does not hold the name only when no other part of the same compound is a key word of the question: 'Hyper V', 'Invoke WebRequest' and 'Break Glass' still find hyper-v, Invoke-WebRequest and break-glass, while long-horizon stays refused for 'VMware Horizon' (changed after the sprint review: the first answer made those questions none)
